title: Units per Shipment of an Existing Tailwise Autoship Re-sized to Its Own Pet
content:
**Household feeding desk — re-sizing an existing subscription**

This rule sets the units per shipment of a non-prescription Autoship under Tailwise Autoship that has been carrying food for more than one pet of the household, written as the subscription's quantity, when another pet of the household gets its own Autoship for the same item and the existing subscription is re-sized to its own pet's usage. The weeks between shipments stay as they are.

Re-sizing is a quantity change to an existing subscription and sits within the Tailwise Autoship change rules for that subscription; the result is a whole number of units within the program's most units per shipment.

## Effect

Once re-sized to its own pet's usage, the subscription's units per shipment become the number set, and every shipment processed from then on carries that many units. The item, the delivery frequency and the next ship date stay unchanged. The customer sees the new quantity right away.

## Recording the quantity: `set_shipment_quantity_8a323a9d`

**Capability.** Sets how many units of the item each shipment of one existing non-prescription Autoship (Autoship Everyday, Autoship Litter & Bulk, Autoship Fresh & Frozen or Autoship Custom Meal Plan) carries. The care agent performs it.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks the tool with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then calls `set_shipment_quantity_8a323a9d` through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

- `autoship_id` — the reference number of the non-prescription Autoship subscription whose quantity is set, as the customer's Autoship subscriptions lookup shows it (Id).
- `quantity` — the units of the item each shipment carries from now on; an integer number of whole units, no decimals.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `autoship_id` (the subscription reference number updated), `quantity` (the units per shipment now on the subscription) and `status`, always `updated` when the change was saved. A status of `updated` is the success receipt.
